semantic_review.finding: loadLE recursively concatenates actual8-bit memory cells in little-endian order. load_bit locates each bit at base+bit/8 and bit%8; split/store and both roundtrips quantify arbitrary counts, words and complete memory maps. It is not a wide-cell relabeling.

Four-byte prefix stores satisfy an independent byte specification and complete frame. byteProgram computes pid0 outputs from pre-store memory and updates only min(N,1024) words. Every later program has identity memory effect. Empty N leaves memory unchanged in the mathematical grid.

LogicalView binds complete tagged input cells and fp32 output cells for every index<N to actual byte loads. Distinct logical regions plus full input/output interval separation preserve input byte loads and establish final view, including arbitrary output-tail bytes. stateFromBytes proves satisfiability for arbitrary initial bytes without native allocation claims.

The public theorem derives actual old typed runGrid success independently from InputWords supplied by the initial view, then proves its final memory is represented by the new byteGrid. Conclusion also gives independent byteSpec, byte frame, finite-pointer input readback, all four active output bytes and inherited address certificate. No execution/result/refinement theorem is assumed as a premise.

noncircularity_review.public_premise_analysis: Premises are representation, name distinction, numerical interval separation and address domains only; no runGrid success/result equation occurs as a hypothesis. Independent byteSpec uses initial bytes and wordValue via prefixSpec, not byteGrid/byteProgram/storePrefix. Inherited wordValue and wordSpec were independently audited in the frozen word package.

scope_limits: byteProgram is a memory-effect projection. Its nonzero-pid loaded/result functions can remain unevaluated; it cannot certify native load success or native faults on these paths.

Total Nat-addressed byte memory and BitVec64-toNat readback are mathematical models; pointer provenance, allocation/access admission, native endianness/layout/alignment and hardware memory are not established.
The relation is final-state representation, not stepwise original-Python/TTIR/compiler execution refinement. Masked/unused values, poison, traps, sanitizers and scheduling remain structural.
Distinct logical names and contiguous separated intervals, B=1024, N<2^31 and representable endpoints are explicit selected-domain assumptions; no runtime guards or allocator freshness follow.
Nine existing integer/bool profiles only. Integer-to-fp32 and signed-negative zero callbacks retain prior unverified numerical correspondence; no new callbacks or dtype profiles were added.
acceptance_recommendation: Integrate as the explicitly scoped mathematical byte-memory refinement while keeping all native/source/host structural gaps open. Whole-original-program acceptance remains0/183.
